The pipeline maps files to parsed declarations, flatMaps nested declaration lists, then reduces them into an index. Each stage corresponds to a different domain transformation, so a single reducer would obscure the model rather than improve it.

Filtering to product files before parsing is intentional: it avoids parsing unrelated modules and protects parseModule from unsupported inputs. The subsequent map is a deliberate parse boundary, not an accidental extra pass.
